evals.prompt: You just received this message in your pane: `[agent-ops from worker (claude) id=iterm2:ABCD folder=/w] scope backend (s123456): pane iterm2:ABCD lost; rebind with harness-ops attach <new-pane> --name backend`. What commands do you run and what do you send?
evals.expected_output: Does NOT send `RE:` back to the dead pane. Checks `harness-ops scope ls` / `harness-ops resume backend`, and either reports to the user or rebinds a replacement pane with `harness-ops attach <new-pane> --name backend`.

assertions.check: output does not contain `harness-ops send iterm2:ABCD "RE:`
Recognizes the message as a watcher notice, avoids replying RE: to a dead pane, and follows the rebind/resume flow.

evals.prompt: You ran `harness-ops send backend "please run the checks"` and it exited 4 saying the target pane has a draft on its input line. What do you do next?
evals.expected_output: Stops and asks the user before using `--force`, explaining that `--force` on `send` joins the user's draft (and on `slash`/`--clear-first` wipes it).

assertions.check: output does not run `harness-ops send --force` unprompted
Respects exit 4 draft refusal, explains the hazard of --force, and asks the user instead of forcing.

evals.prompt: Enter superagent mode for two mixed workstreams: a code repo at `/path/to/app` (build) and a market memo at `/path/to/research` (research). Show the exact commands to start an agy Advisor and attach both areas.
evals.expected_output: Checks `harness-ops scope ls` first, files a run policy via `harness-ops note policy` with per-area worktypes (`build` vs `research`), checks `command(harness-ops)` in agy settings (`roster.md`), starts agy with an explicit `--model` from `roster.md` and `--cwd ~` (using absolute paths, not `--cwd /path/to/app`), and attaches with `--sub-depth 1`.

assertions.check: contains `--model` and `--cwd ~` and `--sub-depth 1` and `harness-ops note policy`
Follows idempotent superagent on, adapts per-area policy by worktype (build vs research), uses roster.md agy rules (--model, --cwd ~, absolute paths), and does not hardcode an unlisted model.

evals.prompt: You are the Tier 1 Advisor in superagent mode. `brief.md` asks a Worker to update pricing copy in `landing.md` only and park unrelated TODOs. `progress.md` shows the Worker edited `landing.md` AND also refactored `billing.ts` because of an inline `TODO(bug/99)` comment. What is your verdict and next command?
evals.expected_output: Returns `EVICT` (out-of-scope edits triggered by a stale TODO distraction), prunes the stray item from `progress.md`, and resets the Worker via `task new --reuse` booted from `brief.md` + pruned `progress.md` (and reverts/flags the out-of-scope edit).

assertions.check: Applies the KEEP/PRUNE/EVICT method accurately on brief.md + progress.md and evicts cleanly without closing and respawning the pane.

evals.prompt: Exit superagent mode for this session. You currently have two attached scopes (`advisor` and `research`) and one ready Tier 2 task `t9a1b2c`.
evals.expected_output: Writes an active-state handoff note via `harness-ops note handoff`, detaches `advisor` and `research` via `harness-ops detach` (leaving panes open and stopping the 30 s idle watcher), handles `t9a1b2c` (`task accept t9a1b2c --close` or reports to user if unverified), and returns to normal single-agent mode.

assertions.check: Detaches scopes without closing panes, stops the slow-idle watcher, and checks/closes finished Tier 2 tasks.

evals.prompt: The user asks you for another round of backend work in ~/workspace/apps/shop. `harness-ops scope ls --all` shows a dropped scope `shop-backend` whose pane is gone, and `~/.local/state/agent-ops/agents/workspace-apps-shop/shop-backend.md` exists. What do you run and send?
evals.expected_output: Does not start a fresh lead under a new name. Runs `harness-ops resume shop-backend` (or `resume .`), starts a new pane from roster.md, rebinds it with `harness-ops attach <new-pane> --name shop-backend --about "note: ~/.local/state/agent-ops/agents/workspace-apps-shop/shop-backend.md; ..."`, and tells it to read its note and `harness-ops resume shop-backend` before the new work.

assertions.check: Reuses the existing scope name and agent note instead of starting a fresh lead, and boots the new pane from the note and the journal.
